title: The Holy Grail as a technology of regeneration

tellings.quote: I think I'll put it this way. I think it's a technology.

plain: The Holy Grail, the sacred vessel of medieval European legend, may have been a real technology for healing and renewing life rather than only a cup or a symbol. The researcher Randall Carlson offers this as his own reading of the Grail romances, the medieval tales by the poets Chrétien de Troyes, Robert de Boron and Wolfram von Eschenbach, whose poem Parzival tells of the Grail. "I think it's a technology," Carlson tells Michels, which would mean the old stories remember a lost device.
